_notes: Run spec for .github/workflows/gates.yml when the branch gates/dispatch is pushed: commit a change here on gates/dispatch (based on the branch under test) and push it. Same fields as the manual inputs: engine_build (released | chromium:<tag or URL>,firefox:<tag or URL>), only (p,a,b,c; c needs the GATES_PROXY secret and runs the OSes one at a time), switches (comma separated, turned off), sites (Gate C site ids, comma separated; empty = all), os (runners: windows, macos, macos-intel; default all three), chrome_channel (stable | beta), chrome_major (the stock Chrome major the control must have; empty = any), firefox_version (stock Firefox control, e.g. 159.0.1). Match the controls to the engines under test.
